title: Roamhaven Rewards Credit Expiry and Forfeiture Terms
content:
## Clause

The whole Roamhaven Rewards balance expires when the member has had no activity for the inactivity period of the member's tier. The balance expires only once that many calendar months have passed since the last activity; the months are added to the last activity date, a month without that day falling back to its last day, and the balance survives through that day. The member is told of the expiry the tier's notice period, counted in calendar days, before it. Reinstated credits unused by their own expiry date expire alone. Closing the membership forfeits the balance where the tier's terms say closure forfeits it. Support never restores expired credits where the tier does not allow goodwill credit.

## The last activity

The clock starts from the member's last activity: the latest posting date among the member's credits-earned entries and credit redemptions, or the date the membership was activated where there is neither. The membership record shows this as its last activity date, and that record, not the member's own account of their activity, is what the clock is read from.

## Counting the period

1. Take the last activity date.
2. Add the inactivity period in whole calendar months, keeping the same day of the month.
3. Where the resulting month has no such day, use the last day of that month.
4. The balance survives through the day so found; it may expire only after that day.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, taking an 18-month inactivity period)

| Last activity date | Day through which the balance survives | Balance on that day | Balance on the following day |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2025 | 15 September 2026 | Survives | May expire |
| 31 August 2024 | 28 February 2026 (February has no 31st) | Survives | May expire (1 March 2026) |
| 30 June 2024 | 30 December 2025 | Survives | May expire (31 December 2025) |

A credit redemption posted on 14 September 2026 by the member whose last activity had been 15 March 2025 becomes the new last activity, and the counting starts again from 14 September 2026.

## Other expiries

| Event | What expires |
|---|---|
| Reinstated credits reach their own expiry date unused | Those reinstated credits alone |
| The membership is closed, where closure forfeits the balance | The balance |
